title: Obligation list (one per pinned clause digest)
description: Splits a pinned clause excerpt into numbered obligations with byte spans into the excerpt. Public files carry byte offsets and our own short labels, never quoted source text. Enforced by scripts/check-obligation-coverage.mjs gate O1; this schema documents the contract and its required[] is drift-pinned by the gate selftest.

clause_digest.description: Digest of the pinned excerpt this list splits. The file name is the digest hex without the sha256: prefix.

clause_path.description: Paragraph path inside the clause, as registered in the clause-snapshot registry.

excerpt_bytes.description: Byte length of the pinned excerpt; O1 checks every span against it.

split_by.description: Model or person that made the split. Must be a model that did not build the covered node.

reviewed_by.description: A different model or person that reviewed the split; must differ from split_by (O1).

label.description: Our own short paraphrase of what the span requires. Never a verbatim quote of the source text.

start.description: Byte offset into the excerpt, inclusive.

end.description: Byte offset into the excerpt, exclusive (Buffer.slice semantics).

kind.description: A definition needs no vector of its own.
